content: If you have any allergies, including to this medication or other substances, inform your healthcare provider. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. This medication may occasionally cause dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision. The consumption of alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate these effects. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities that require alertness or clear vision until you are certain you can perform them safely. Limit your intake of alcoholic beverages. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, inform your doctor. You should not become pregnant while using midodrine, as it may harm an unborn baby. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Some products may contain ingredients that could elevate your blood pressure. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Regularly monitor your blood pressure in different positions (lying down, sitting, and standing) and share the results with your doctor. Laboratory and medical tests, such as kidney and liver function tests, should be conducted while you are taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
